name: Spinach Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs and milk in a small bowl with a pinch of salt and black pepper.
Melt butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat and sauté the spinach until wilted (approx 1-2 mins).
Pour the whisked egg mixture evenly over the spinach.
Sprinkle cheese over one half as the eggs set.
Fold over and cook for another 30 seconds until golden and melted. Serve hot.
tags: Quick, High Protein, Breakfast, Low Carb

name: Creamy Garlic Chicken
instructions: Season chicken slices with salt, pepper, and herbs.
Heat olive oil and butter in a pan over medium-high heat. Sear chicken until golden on both sides (6-8 minutes), then set aside.
Add minced garlic to the same pan and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in milk and simmer gently, stirring to deglaze the pan.
Add spinach and return chicken to pan. Simmer for 3 minutes until sauce thickens. Serve with rice or pasta.

name: Classic Tomato Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Scramble beaten eggs in 1 tbsp oil in a hot wok until soft, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil, sauté onion and garlic until aromatic.
Add diced tomatoes and cook until juicy and slightly saucy.
Add cold cooked rice, break up any clumps, and toss well with the tomato sauce.
Fold in scrambled eggs, season with salt and pepper, and stir-fry for 2 minutes.

name: Berry Yogurt Parfait
instructions: Spoon half of the yogurt into a tall glass or bowl.
Layer with half the sliced banana and diced apple.
Add remaining yogurt and top with fresh fruits.
Drizzle with honey or maple syrup and enjoy immediately.
tags: Healthy, No Cook, Vegetarian, High Protein

name: Hearty Vegetable Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Sauté onion and garlic until soft (3 mins).
Add carrots and potatoes, cooking for 5 minutes.
Stir in tomatoes, water or broth, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 20 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Stir in spinach during the last 2 minutes until wilted. Serve warm.
tags: Vegan, Comfort Food, Low Calorie, Meal Prep

name: Creamy Tomato Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta in salted water according to package instructions; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water and drain.
In a skillet, melt butter with olive oil over medium heat. Sauté garlic until aromatic.
Add tomatoes and cook down for 8 minutes until a rich sauce forms.
Stir in milk and cheese, creating a silky pink sauce.
Toss drained pasta in the sauce, adding a splash of pasta water if needed. Serve hot.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
instructions: Mash bananas thoroughly with a fork in a mixing bowl.
Whisk in eggs and milk until a smooth batter forms.
Melt a dab of butter in a pan over medium-low heat.
Pour 1/4 cup batter for each pancake. Cook until bubbles form (2-3 mins), then flip and cook 1 more minute.
Stack and serve warm with fruit or honey.

name: Crispy Garlic Potato Wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F) or preheat air fryer.
Toss potato wedges with olive oil, melted butter, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Spread wedges in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast for 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden and crispy.
Serve with your favorite dip.

name: Cucumber Yogurt Tzatziki Salad
instructions: Squeeze excess water out of the grated cucumber using a clean towel.
In a bowl, combine Greek yogurt, grated garlic, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Fold in the drained cucumber, and season with salt and pepper.
Chill for 15 minutes before serving with pita, grilled meat, or chips.

name: Lemon Herb Roast Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F).
Arrange chicken pieces and cubed potatoes in a roasting tray.
Rub chicken with softened butter, lemon juice, olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and oregano.
Tuck lemon slices around chicken and potatoes.
Roast for 40-45 minutes until chicken skin is golden and internal temp reaches 75°C.

name: Stir-Fried Beef and Bell Pepper
instructions: Season beef strips with salt, black pepper, and 1 tsp cornstarch or soy sauce if available.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat. Sear beef for 2-3 minutes until browned; set aside.
Add remaining oil and stir fry garlic, onion, and bell peppers for 3 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return beef to the wok, toss everything together for 1 minute, and serve with rice.
tags: High Protein, Quick Dinner, Asian Style

name: Pan-Seared Salmon with Lemon Butter
instructions: Pat salmon fillets dry and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Place salmon skin-side down for 4-5 mins.
Flip salmon, add butter, minced garlic, and lemon juice to pan. Baste salmon with spoon for 3 mins.
Sauté spinach in pan juices for 1 minute and serve hot.

name: Warm Apple Cinnamon Slices
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Add apple slices and sprinkle cinnamon.
Sauté for 6-8 minutes until apples are tender and caramelized.
Serve warm topped with a dollop of cold yogurt.

name: Loaded Breakfast Scramble
instructions: Melt butter in a pan and sauté diced onion and bell peppers for 3 minutes.
Add diced tomatoes and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in whisked eggs and gently fold over medium-low heat until creamy curds form.
Remove from heat, stir in cheese, and season with salt and pepper.

name: Carrot Ginger Infused Soup
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter until soft.
Add carrots and 2 cups of water or broth; simmer for 15 minutes until carrots are soft.
Blend using an immersion blender until smooth.
Stir in milk, season with salt and pepper, and warm gently.
